day_shape: 83 items: Pezeshkian addresses UNGA with Iran declaring 'defence doctrine has changed', CENTCOM reports 115 vessels redirected under Hormuz blockade with cargo ship struck, IDF announces killing of Hamas hostage-holder commander and finance chief, Canada and UAE add Iran sanctions, no UK or US State Dept designations in feed.

threads.label: Pezeshkian UNGA speech and Tehran messaging
threads.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the UN General Assembly responding to Trump's remarks, with the judiciary head and acting defence minister amplifying his line that Iran cannot be destroyed. Regime channels quoted General Ibn al-Reza saying Iran's 'defence doctrine has changed' and expert commentators framing Pezeshkian as prosecutor of the US and Israel.

threads.label: US-Iran talks and internal Tehran split
threads.summary: Iran International reported US-Iran talks in New York ended divided over ending the war, with hardliners in Tehran condemning reported contact between Khamenei adviser figures and Washington. INSS's Beni Sabti told the Jerusalem Post that Witkoff-Kushner indirect talks were a 'half-truth', while Rubio reaffirmed US defence commitments to Saudi Arabia.

threads.label: Hormuz blockade and shipping
threads.summary: CENTCOM's Adm. Brad Cooper said 115 commercial vessels have been redirected under the US 'steel wall' blockade, and the Jerusalem Post reported two casualties from a cargo vessel struck in the Strait of Hormuz. Defa Press quoted General Safavi claiming Iran and Oman had agreed a Hormuz management mechanism and that the strait would 'never return to its former state'.

threads.label: IDF Gaza and West Bank operations
threads.summary: The IDF announced killing Hamas commander Mahmoud Abd al-Fattah Awad, who held seven named hostages including Naama Levy and Omri Miran, and Hamas finance head Muhammad Abu Alwan who moved over 1 billion NIS. Combat engineers found a 600-metre tunnel crossing the Yellow Line, and a reserve soldier was severely wounded in a car-ramming at a Binyamin Brigade checkpoint.

threads.label: Gaza ceasefire status and Hamas position
threads.summary: Hamas said it was ready to implement the Board of Peace roadmap for Gaza and blamed Israel for obstruction, warning of a complete collapse of the ceasefire. IRIB cited Hamas naming the 'Special Coordination Committee' and Nikolai Mladinov as failing to compel compliance.

threads.label: Sanctions, aviation and China supply
threads.summary: Canada sanctioned five Iranian individuals and five entities over rights violations, the UAE central bank imposed restrictions on Bank Melli branches, and Iran threatened to disrupt regional airports if its flights are barred while China's foreign ministry said it would not comply with US sanctions. The WSJ, cited by Iran International, reported around 1,300 Chinese dual-use shipments to Iran's defence ministry in H1 2026.

threads.label: Iran domestic: schools, economy, security
threads.summary: Iran International and the Jerusalem Post reported the school year opening under the shadow of January protest killings and the war, with thousands of primary-age children unable to attend for financial reasons, while Khamenei's office issued messages marking the opening of schools and honouring martyred pupils. The Jerusalem Post reported IRGC Brig.-Gen. Hossein Zarifi was killed in clashes in southeastern Iran, and Iran International said war had deepened an energy crunch before winter.

events.title_en: Heavy toll of Iran war on Europe; 270 million euros daily additional fuel costs
events.summary_en: Heavy toll of Iran war on Europe; 270 million euros daily additional fuel costs. Euronews, citing estimates from a transport and environment advocacy group based in Brussels, reported that since the start of the Iran war, the fuel price increase in road transport has imposed approximately 53 billion euros in additional costs to the European Union. According to the report, the bulk of these additional costs, equivalent to 40 billion euros, relates to diesel, and the fuel price increase in the road transport sector has added on average 270 million euros daily to transport costs, of which 203 million euros relates to diesel and 67 million euros to petrol.

events.summary_en: Hamas warning over complete collapse of Gaza ceasefire agreement. Hamas spokesperson, while emphasising the movement's complete readiness to implement the Gaza peace roadmap, warned that the complete collapse of the ceasefire agreement stems from the occupying regime's refusal to abide by it and the failure of the 'Special Coordination Committee' and its representative 'Nikolai Mladinov' to compel Israel to implement the agreement. He called for facilitating the entry of the technocrat committee and the beginning of the deployment of international forces in the Gaza Strip.

events.title_en: Pezeshkian: the rooted and civilised nation of Iran cannot be destroyed
events.summary_en: Pezeshkian: the rooted and civilised nation of Iran cannot be destroyed. The president, referring to Trump's remarks, said: The claim of destroying a country and nation is unprecedented, and even former US officials would not have raised it so brazenly; at the same time, they cannot destroy Iran. Iran is a country with roots in history, and despite all the pressures they apply, our people are present in the arena. Our people's presence is commendable and I hope we do not disappoint our dear nation. Our presence here is aimed at dialogue and defence of the rightful position of our oppressed and mighty people, and it has been effective thus far. I hope that going forward we can also carry out this mission well.

events.title: Khamenei adviser says Tehran can negotiate, hardliners say it must not

events.title: Iran warns oil pollution spreading along southern coast could last years
events.summary: Oil pollution has spread along parts of Iran’s Hormozgan coast and reached the entrances of shrimp farming channels in Sirik, with environmental officials warning that some of the contamination could remain in the marine environment for years.
